name: The Ritz-Carlton Hotel de la Paix
positioning: Historic lakefront hotel in Geneva, officially The Ritz-Carlton Hotel de la Paix, Geneva, open since 1865 with views over Lake Geneva and the Alps
best_for: Travelers who want a historic Geneva hotel with lake views
Guests interested in unusual dining and Swiss watchmaking

facts.text: The hotel has panoramic views over Lake Geneva and the Alps.
The hotel was inaugurated in 1865 under the name Hôtel de la Paix.
Geneva State Council hosted an official dinner at the Hôtel de la Paix on September 7, 1872, concluding the Alabama arbitration.
The Living Room offers internationally inspired menus all day, including weekend brunch and à-la-carte breakfast.
Fiskebar serves fresh, casually elevated cuisine in a lakeside setting.
The menu at FRED Bar is influenced by artwork on display.
The hotel has La Vallée Spa Suites, and the entire spa can be fully privatised.
Hotel guests have complimentary access to Holmes Place.
The 2-Bedroom Lakefront Suite has a private balcony with views of Lake Geneva, the Jet d'Eau and Mont Blanc.
Signature Suite stays include two-way transfers, daily breakfast and privileged access to the spa.

highlights.text: Dans le Noir? is a restaurant where guests dine in darkness, guided by visually impaired personnel.
The Grace Kelly Suite is named after Grace Kelly, one of the hotel's guests.
Bucherer watchmakers guide guests through Swiss watchmaking at the hotel.
An exhibition of tapestries celebrates historical figures who attended the hotel, from Giuseppe Garibaldi to Victor Hugo.

considerations.text: Breakfast at The Living Room is available for a fee.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that may not suit budget-conscious travelers.
